items.title_en: ‘How Do You Guys Manage Life?’: Kolkata Techie With ₹1-2 LPA Salary Seeks Advice, Reddit Responds
items.title_zh: “你们如何管理生活？”：工资为 1-2 卢比 LPA 的加尔各答技术人员寻求建议，Reddit 回应
items.summary_en: A Reddit post by an employee earning ₹1-2 LPA has sparked a discussion about surviving on a low salary, career growth, upskilling and the struggle to save money
items.summary_zh: 一名赚取 1-2 卢比 LPA 的员工在 Reddit 上发帖，引发了关于低薪生存、职业发展、技能提升和省钱斗争的讨论
